meditation.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

Te adoro, oh Padre eterno, y te doy gracias en nombre de tu amada hija, Santa María Magdalena de Pazzi, por todas las gracias que le concediste, y en particular por haberla elegido como lugar de reposo de tu Ser divino, de aquel modo y en la medida en que las criaturas mortales pueden ser capaces de ello, y por haberle prometido concederle todo lo que te pidiera, diciéndole: Esposa de mi Verbo unigénito, pídeme lo que quieras.

Te suplico, por sus méritos y oraciones, que infundas en mi corazón una verdadera humildad y conformidad con tu divina voluntad.

Te adoro, oh Jesús, Verbo encarnado, y te doy gracias en nombre de tu amantísima esposa, Santa María Magdalena de Pazzi, por todos los dones que le concediste, especialmente por aquellos cinco con los que la adornaste.

Con tus sacratísimos estigmas.

Cuando le pusiste un anillo en el dedo, como a una esposa.

Cuando le diste tu propio Corazón, como a una verdadera amante.

Cuando la coronaste con tu sacratísima corona de espinas.

Cuando tu santísima Madre la cubrió con el velo de la pureza, y tú le concediste aquel sufrimiento que ella tanto deseaba.

Te suplico, por sus méritos y oraciones, que me concedas la gracia de imitarte a ti y a ella, y en particular de estar dispuesto a sufrir por tu amor, y concédeme también, te lo ruego, una perfecta observancia de tu ley divina y de tus consejos.

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

Te adoro, oh Espíritu Paráclito, y te doy gracias, en nombre de tu querida discípula, Santa María Magdalena de Pazzi, por todos los dones que le concediste, por haberla elegido como tu grata morada, y en particular por las siete veces que te infundiste en aquella alma purísima, bajo siete formas diversas, de nube, de fuego, de columna, de río, de paloma, de viento y de llamas, para fortalecerla en las tentaciones y sufrimientos que había de soportar durante los cinco años de su prueba, haciéndola victoriosa sobre el mismo infierno.

Te suplico, oh Espíritu de soberana bondad, que me concedas fortaleza en todas las adversidades y tentaciones de la vida y de la muerte, y que enciendas en mi corazón una llama ardiente de tu amor.

Padre nuestro.

Dios te salve, María.

Gloria al Padre.

¡Santa María Magdalena de Pazzi, ruega por nosotros!

En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.
meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

I adore Thee, O Eternal Father, and I thank Thee on the part of Thy beloved Daughter, St Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, for all the graces Thou granted her, and in particular for having chosen her as the resting place of Thy Divine Being, in that manner, and as far as mortal creatures can become capable thereof, and for having promised her to grant her whatsoever she would ask Thee, saying to her, Bride of My Only-Begotten Word, ask of Me what thou wilt.

I beg of Thee, for the sake of her merits and prayers, to infuse into my heart a true humility and conformity to Thy Divine Will.

I adore Thee, O Jesus, Word Incarnate, and I thank Thee, on the part of Thy most loving Bride, St Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, for all the gifts Thou granted her, especially for those five with which Thou didst adorn her.

With Thy most sacred stigmata.

When Thou didst place a ring on her finger, as to a bride.

When Thou gavest her Thy own Heart, as to a true lover.

When Thou didst crown her with Thy most sacred crown of thorns.

When Thy most holy Mother covered her with the veil of purity, and Thou didst grant her that suffering so much wished for by her.

I beg of Thee, for the sake of her merits and prayers, to grant me the grace of imitating Thee and her, and particularly of being willing to suffer for Thy love, and grant me also, I beseech Thee, a perfect observance of Thy divine law and counsels.

I especially ask in this novena for the grace of

(mention request here…)

I adore Thee, O Spirit Paraclete, and I thank Thee, in the name of Thy dear Disciple, St Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, for all the gifts granted her by Thee, for having chosen her for Thy agreeable dwelling place, and particularly for the seven times Thou didst infuse Thyself into that most pure soul, under seven various forms of cloud, of fire, of column, of river, of dove, of wind, and of flames, in order to strengthen her in the temptations and sufferings she was to endure during the five years of her trial, having made her victorious over hell itself.

I beg of Thee, O Spirit of Sovereign Goodness, to grant me strength in all adversities and temptations in life and death, and to enkindle in my heart a burning flame of Thy Love.

Our Father

Hail Mary

Glory Be

Saint Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, pray for us!

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

prayer.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

I adore Thee, O Eternal Father, and I thank Thee on the part of Thy beloved Daughter, St Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, for all the graces Thou granted her, and in particular for having chosen her as the resting place of Thy Divine Being, in that manner, and as far as mortal creatures can become capable thereof, and for having promised her to grant her whatsoever she would ask Thee, saying to her, Bride of My Only-Begotten Word, ask of Me what thou wilt.

I beg of Thee, for the sake of her merits and prayers, to infuse into my heart a true humility and conformity to Thy Divine Will.

I adore Thee, O Jesus, Word Incarnate, and I thank Thee, on the part of Thy most loving Bride, St Mary Magdalene de Pazzi, for all the gifts Thou granted her, especially for those five with which Thou didst adorn her.

With Thy most sacred stigmata.

When Thou didst place a ring on her finger, as to a bride.

When Thou gavest her Thy own Heart, as to a true lover.

When Thou didst crown her with Thy most sacred crown of thorns.

When Thy most holy Mother covered her with the veil of purity, and Thou didst grant her that suffering so much wished for by her.

I beg of Thee, for the sake of her merits and prayers, to grant me the grace of imitating Thee and her, and particularly of being willing to suffer for Thy love, and grant me also, I beseech Thee, a perfect observance of Thy divine law and counsels.
